card.title: Pixel 6a Vibration and Haptics Not Working

source.title: Pixel 6a Vibration and Haptics Not Working

claims.statement: Pixel 6a haptics dying after quick key presses (logs show cs40l26 polling errors / Vibrator HAL failures) is often weak spring contacts between the board and vibrator; gently bend the board pins up (and vibrator pins down) for firmer contact.

procedure: Hard reset (power + volume up 30 s) to confirm it returns then fails.
Gently bend the board contacts up / vibrator contacts down.
Reassemble; check for tension when screwing the midframe.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
